selection_rule.primary: mean CLIP on near_training + generalization (12 matched cases)
selection_rule.eligibility: control mean delta versus current >= -0.01 and blind review no systematic severe regression
selection_rule.claim: candidate only; improvement requires independent confirmation
selection_rule.blind_review: per-image prompt adherence, subject anatomy, visual quality; 0=bad,1=mixed,2=good; equal ties allowed
